answer: Per-Identity Ramp Terrace: each new identity must sustain a rising floor of daily outbound traffic for 14 days before gaining full API quota, ramping from 1% to 100%. The island of low-volume probes is invisible, and a shared vault of deferred requests doesn't count—only live, timestamped sends do. Enforcement is a rolling median over that window; dips reset the clock. An attacker pays 14 days of real infrastructure per identity, turning mass registration into a linear time cost that removes the payoff of bulk spawning.
